members.name: deal_v2
members.instructions: A buyer and a seller negotiate the price of a Craigslist item over chat. Afterwards the buyer submitted a final offer that the seller accepted (deal) or not (no deal); that step is not shown. Judge from the chat how it most likely ended. Pick the option that best describes the end of the chat.

criteria.agreed_explicit: One side proposes a price and the other explicitly accepts it ('deal', 'sounds good', 'ok', 'I'll take it', 'that works').
criteria.agreed_implied: They clearly settle on a price without saying 'deal', e.g. arranging pickup, delivery or payment at that price.
criteria.late_counter_unanswered: After a real back-and-forth with several prices exchanged, the chat ends with a counteroffer (often a compromise) that the other side has not answered yet; the two are close to agreeing.
criteria.opening_offer_unanswered: The chat ends with the first price offer of the conversation (or the only one) and no reply to it; there was no real back-and-forth on price.
criteria.rejected: One side refuses the last offer, says they are too far apart, walks away, or says the price does not work, with no later agreement.
criteria.no_price: The chat ends before any price is discussed: only greetings, item questions, or off-topic messages.

members.name: deal_v2b
members.instructions: This is a Craigslist price negotiation between a buyer and a seller. After the chat, the buyer formally submitted an offer and the seller either accepted it or not; that step is hidden. Based on how the chat ends, which situation is this?

criteria.agreed_explicit: A price was proposed and the other party clearly said yes to it (e.g. 'deal', 'ok', 'works for me', 'I accept').
criteria.agreed_implied: No explicit 'yes', but the two plainly settled on a price, for example by arranging when to pick up, deliver or pay.
criteria.late_counter_unanswered: Both sides had already traded several prices, and the chat stops on a counteroffer or 'final price' that has not been answered; they are close to a deal.
criteria.opening_offer_unanswered: The only price offer in the chat (often the buyer's first offer) is left unanswered; price was never really negotiated back and forth.
criteria.rejected: The last offer was turned down or someone walked away (too far apart, can't go that low/high, no thanks), and nothing was agreed afterwards.
criteria.no_price: No price was ever discussed: the chat has only greetings, questions about the item, or unrelated talk.
